context: A host at a coastal wildlife rescue centre gives a volunteer induction talk.

sub_blocks.word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER
Choose the correct letter, A, B or C. Options are on the question paper only.

lines.text: Now turn to Section Two. You will hear a talk for new volunteers at a wildlife rescue centre.
Questions eleven to fifteen. Complete the notes below. Write no more than two words and/or a number for each answer. First, you have some time to look at questions eleven to fifteen.
Now listen and answer questions eleven to fifteen.
Welcome to Saltmarsh Wildlife Rescue. I'm your induction host for this morning's volunteer briefing.
The centre is open to the public from nine a.m. to five p.m. every day except Monday, when we close for deep cleaning.
Volunteer shifts last four hours, including a short break — four hours, not a full day.
You must be at least sixteen to volunteer without a parent on site.
Please bring waterproof boots — the paths stay muddy after high tide.
Hot drinks are free in the staff canteen; please don't eat in the animal areas.

Questions sixteen to twenty. Which part of the site is each facility in? Choose the correct letter, A, B or C. The options are on your question paper only. First, you have some time to look at questions sixteen to twenty.
Now listen and answer questions sixteen to twenty.
Look at the site layout in your booklet. I'll walk you through it without reading the letters.
If you start in the north yard, that's where we keep the isolation kennels — new arrivals stay there until a vet has checked them.
lines.note: Paper: A North yard; B Main building; C Shore path. Isolation kennels = north yard.

lines.text: The shop is inside the main building, just beyond the reception desk — postcards and feed, not outdoor stalls.
Follow the shore path and you'll reach the bird pools, where recovering seabirds practise swimming before release.
Training sessions are also in the main building, in the upstairs classroom — not in the yard.
And the bike racks for volunteers sit in the north yard beside the staff gate, so you don't block the public car park.
I'll take questions at the end of the tour. Thank you.
That is the end of Section Two. Now turn to Section Three.
